status: Component differential evidence for the pinned slot-lock faults and the complete /antigravity menu walk; loaded host boundary checked for the existing enrollment scenario; platform execution beyond Linux and live vault acceptance remain pending
compared: Renewable lease corrupt owner identity: non-string ownerId, boolean/array/object/hex/padded/negative/zero expiresAt, extra fields, symlink and legacy-directory owners
Eviction-marker corruption: a regular-file marker, a malformed owner file, a foreign owner at fresh and stale ages
Lease loss and compromise: assert and renewal against a malformed, directory-replaced or removed lease, and a marker stolen during renewal or release
Cancellation before commit: a lease destroyed while held is not revived, and a released lease is not removed when its marker was stolen
Credential slot: a second instance restores or refuses after a foreign login, and an interrupted auth or stash rename stays recoverable
Competing processes: a real child process holds the pinned lease, a contender is refused, the child releases, and a successor acquires the freed path
Every deterministic /antigravity walk: exact select/confirm/notify UI trace, callback order, confirmation true/false, cancellation at the root, section, entry and item levels, and refusal projection
Exact informational and error notification strings for use/decline/accept/use-vault/use-local/forget/request-access

approvedException.behavior: The original Node 24 body read stays pending after an idle timeout or cancellation; the native transport returns the timeout/cancellation error and releases its request.
approvedException.regression: tests/ag3_cancellation.rs::body_read_timeout_and_cancel_return_the_error_and_release_the_request pins the exact error text and the released socket.

checks.note: Loaded Linux host boundary: proposal, pending approval after menu closure, backup/marker before custody, account controls, cancelled disconnect and confirmed restoration. Requires RPI_TEST_HOST, RPI_TEST_PROVIDER_LIBRARY, RPI_PRIVATE_TMP, RPI_REFERENCE_NODE and RPI_REFERENCE_DIR.

notTested: The bare Rust credential slot intentionally has no inner Pi mkdir/mtime lock: native rpi runs it under the host credentialStoreLock. Bare-slot scenarios that would trip that lock (for example a read-only auth directory) are therefore not differentially comparable and are excluded.
The loaded host binary used for the ignored test and the native menu script was built from a sibling host lane's target directory; rebuilding the host is outside this lane.
Competing-process contention is captured for the pinned renewable lease. Cross-process contention at the native credentialStoreLock boundary (two host processes) is not scripted here.
macOS and Windows execution was not performed; the slot and lease code cross-checks on Rust 1.78 but only Linux ran.
Live vault enrollment, custody send and inference are out of scope and were not exercised.
